name: application-grade-badge-scale
title: Grade Badge Scale
description: A–F letter grade badges and percentage-paired grade pills on a consistent green-to-red color scale, for academic or evaluation scoring contexts.
useWhen: Displaying an academic or evaluation grade (A–F) where a consistent, quickly scannable color scale communicates performance at a glance.
Pairing a letter grade with its underlying percentage in a list of graded assignments or submissions.
avoidWhen: The badge represents a generic status or category rather than a graded score — use the plain badges component instead, since the green-to-red scale specifically implies performance quality.
You need more than 5 grade tiers or a continuous score — a progress bar or gauge better communicates a continuous value than discrete letter badges.
responsiveBehavior: Both variants are compact inline elements that wrap naturally in a flex row or list; no responsive breakpoints are needed.
accessibility: Each round letter-only badge carries a title attribute spelling out 'Grade: A' etc., giving assistive tech and mouse users alike a full-text equivalent beyond the single letter.
The percentage-paired pill shows both the letter and the number as visible text, so the grade is never conveyed by color alone.
The green-to-red hue scale is paired with distinct letters (A/B/C/D/F) so the grade remains distinguishable for colorblind users.
